Title: AI CLI service: the four containments as refusals, plus the session launch
CodeSymbol: ai_cli_service.assert_effective_account; ai_cli_service.assert_service_account; ai_cli_service.collect_sudoers_lines; ai_cli_service.assert_safe_template; ai_cli_service.assert_safe_env; ai_cli_service.resolve_executable; ai_cli_service.docker_bridge_addresses; ai_cli_service.resolve_bind; ai_cli_service.request_scratch; ai_cli_service.startup_checks; ai_cli_service.handle_ask; setup-ai-cli.sh
Detail: Each acceptance property is a REFUSAL in code rather than a line in a unit file, and after the 2026-09-09 cross-review each is about IDENTITY rather than the presence of a string. (1) ACCOUNT: assert_effective_account compares the configured account with the account this process is actually running as and refuses a mismatch or an undeterminable identity; setup-ai-cli.sh generates the unit User=/Group= drop-in from the same AI_CLI_USER knob, so the asserted account and the running account cannot differ; assert_service_account still rejects hub/root, a privileged group and a sudoers mention, and collect_sudoers_lines FOLLOWS #include/#includedir/@include, refusing to certify an include it could not read. (2) TEMPLATE: assert_safe_template pins argv[0] to the family executable and validates every token against that executable declared vocabulary in FAMILY_CONTRACTS - unknown token, duplicate flag, wrong-valued flag (--allowedTools/--disallowedTools/--sandbox/--permission-mode/-c), path-carrying executable and service-appended flag are all refusals; assert_safe_env allow-lists the Env cell so a row cannot set PATH/HOME/CODEX_HOME; resolve_executable resolves the pinned name only on AI_CLI_BIN_PATH and refuses a group/other-writable binary. It runs at startup AND at every launch because the registry can be edited on the box. (3) BIND: resolve_bind rejects the wildcard by name and accepts a non-loopback address only when a local docker bridge interface is actually carrying it (docker_bridge_addresses over sysfs), before the socket exists; bind_family serves IPv6 when the accepted address is IPv6. (4) SCRATCH: request_scratch gives one mkdtemp 0700 directory per request and removes it on every exit path, a failed removal being reported and raised rather than swallowed. Registry loading and the prompt-on-stdin/--output-last-message session decisions reuse ai-template structure (its IF-045/IF-064) and none of its flags. setup-ai-cli.sh re-checks the account privilege on every boot and runs the service own --check AS that account.

Title: One pure decision returning BOTH the backlight and the power action
CodeSymbol: wall_occupancy.decide; wall_occupancy.read_presence; wall_occupancy.in_on_period; wall_occupancy.parse_hhmm; wall-sleep.sh run_occupancy; wall-sleep.sh suspend_now
Detail: decide() is a total, I/O-free function of (now, minute-of-day, presence, absent_since, the knobs) returning one record carrying backlight in {on,off,unchanged} AND power in {stay,suspend}; wall-sleep.sh's run_occupancy applies that record and re-derives neither half, so the two behaviours cannot diverge. Branch order is the requirement: detection-off returns 'unchanged' first so no later line can act on a panel that opted out; presence returns 'stay' next so no absence branch is reachable while somebody is there; the on-period gates the suspend structurally rather than by timer length. read_presence returns ABSENT only for a fresh, schemaVersion-1, positively-absent file and PRESENT for every other outcome including OSError and a future timestamp beyond MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS. suspend_now holds SN-013's arm-then-suspend guard for BOTH the scheduled and the occupancy path, so a refused rtcwake degrades to backlight-off in one place. The absence clock lives under /run so a mains blip restarts it, is written atomically (temp file + rename) and range-checked on read, and is CLEARED for every minute that is present or inside the on-period - so the timeout measures absence spent OUTSIDE the on-period and an absence begun inside it cannot carry across the boundary. read_presence rejects the non-finite JSON constants and any observedAt/ttlMs that is not finite, because NaN makes every freshness comparison false. arm_rtc establishes the RTC frame from timedatectl/etc-adjtime (UTC on this image) rather than asserting -l, targets the next LOCAL CALENDAR occurrence of the wake time rather than now+86400, and READS THE ALARM BACK from the rtc sysfs node - a zero exit from rtcwake is not evidence an alarm exists. run_occupancy refuses the suspend when the backlight could not be turned off. wall-firstboot.sh step 6b enables or disables wall-occupancy.timer from the same knob and fails the step loudly if the knob is on while the unit or the decider is absent.

Title: AI CLI service: bounded launches on a small always-on box
CodeSymbol: ai_cli_service.RouteGate; ai_cli_service.kill_process_group; ai_cli_service.extract_result; ai_cli_service.make_handler; ai_cli_service.make_server; ai_cli_service.bind_family
Detail: RouteGate takes the availability decision, the launch claim and the cooldown under ONE lock: a row already in flight is unavailable, so a burst cannot slip between the check and the claim; every completed call cools the row (AI_CLI_SUCCESS_COOLDOWN_SECONDS after a success, AI_CLI_COOLDOWN_SECONDS after a failure); at most AI_CLI_MAX_CONCURRENT sessions run at once across all rows and a further request is 503, not a queue. The HTTP shell refuses a request with no Content-Length (411) and one above AI_CLI_MAX_BODY_BYTES (413) BEFORE reading a byte, carries AI_CLI_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS on the connection, and caps concurrent connections at AI_CLI_MAX_CONNECTIONS. run_session starts the child in its own session and a timeout kills the whole process GROUP, so no grandchild outlives it. extract_result requires a genuine typed result - a result frame, not flagged is_error, whose result is not null, or for a last-message family a non-empty parseable last-message file - so a zero exit with no answer is a 502, never a 200 carrying null.

Title: AI-usage feeder: the unavailable path, the one writable file, and the refused destination
CodeSymbol: ai_usage_feeder.build_post; ai_usage_feeder.build_gauge; ai_usage_feeder.is_fresh; ai_usage_feeder.open_for_write; ai_usage_feeder.resolve_identity; ai_usage_feeder.resolve_enabled; ai_usage_feeder.resolve_feed_url; ai_usage_feeder.is_local_destination; ai_usage_feeder.parse_codex; ai_usage_feeder.parse_claude; ai_usage_feeder.parse_opencode; ai_usage_feeder.check_percent; ai_usage_feeder.window_kind_for; ai_usage_feeder.run_cycle
Detail: build_post carries the whole 'never a green gauge' rule as ONE invariant - observed_at == now IF AND ONLY IF this cycle read the source - so every failure class collapses to one SourceFailure and one path: repost the last value at the stamp it was TRUE, or, with no history, a gauge with no observed_at at all (stale on arrival, so the panel says 'unavailable' rather than showing nothing). build_gauge is the only place a body is assembled and it enforces the tightened wire shape: value and target always present, min/max always sent because % has no inferable width, direction emitted iff window is, and no severity, css or colour ever - NagLight owns those. open_for_write is the ONLY writing door and is an ALLOW-LIST of one path plus its .tmp sibling, so 'never writes a vendor credential file' does not depend on knowing where the next CLI version puts its token; read_secret_file has no write mode at all. resolve_identity and resolve_feed_url REFUSE rather than default: a blank identity would put one household member's usage on another's board, and is_local_destination requires an address a docker bridge is ACTUALLY carrying rather than membership of 172.16.0.0/12 - the range that contains real household LANs, which is the lesson resolve_bind learned in the SR-019 cross-review. run_cycle reads each source in its own try so one failing vendor cannot blank the panel, asserted in BOTH source orders after the 2026-09-09 mutation run found the single-order test vacuous.

Title: Weight feeder: the stale-never-green invariant, the definitions-resident goal, and the one writable file
CodeSymbol: weight_feeder.build_post; weight_feeder.gauge_body; weight_feeder.is_fresh; weight_feeder.iso8601_utc; weight_feeder.load_goal_from_definitions; weight_feeder.find_goal_in_frontmatter; weight_feeder.parse_goal_text; weight_feeder.open_for_write; weight_feeder.check_pounds; weight_feeder.grams_to_pounds; weight_feeder.resolve_identity; weight_feeder.resolve_enabled; weight_feeder.resolve_feed_url; weight_feeder.is_local_destination; weight_feeder.enabled_source; weight_feeder.read_google_health; weight_feeder.run_cycle
Detail: build_post carries the whole 'stale, never green' rule as ONE invariant - the body carries a stamp from this cycle IF AND ONLY IF this cycle read the source - so every failure class collapses to one SourceFailure and one path: repost the last weight at the stamp it was TRUE, or, with no history, value 0 with no observed_at at all (stale on arrival, so the panel says 'unavailable' rather than showing nothing where a bar belongs). run_cycle does not write state on a failed read, so that original stamp cannot decay into permanent freshness. gauge_body is the only place a body is assembled and it enforces the weight wire shape, which differs from the usage feeder's in three ways that are each a 400 or a silent lie: no min/max because `lb` is the one unit NagLight infers a range for and the range rule stays in the tracker; no window and therefore no direction, which NagLight refuses without one; and an RFC3339 observed_at rather than an integer, which fails as a permanently stale gauge rather than loudly. load_goal_from_definitions is the acceptance criterion's second half: the goal is a top-level `weight_goal_lb` frontmatter key in the user's own definitions, which internal/defs ignores as an unknown top-level key, so it needs no NagLight change to be stored and rides the existing Drive sync. It REFUSES rather than defaults - an unusable or duplicated declaration is an error, not 'no goal', because a typo'd 1800 would drag the inferred bar to 1775..1825 and paint every real reading full red with nothing saying why - and a missing goal aborts the cycle WITHOUT posting, which is a different refusal from a missing source because the target line IS the goal. read_google_health deliberately contains NO PARSER: the API, the Weight type, the route and the scope were verified against Google on 2026-09-09 but no authenticated call has ever been made, and a weight parser written from a schema posts a confident, plausible, wrong body weight instead of failing. open_for_write is the ONLY writing door and is an ALLOW-LIST of one path plus its .tmp sibling, so the Google Health refresh token is unwritable by construction rather than by knowing its name.
